name: Dogecoin

key_findings: Clean Regulatory Clarity Pass -- explicitly named in the March 17, 2026 SEC-CFTC joint interpretive release, no litigation ever, no issuer to enforce against.

Regulatory & Risk (82) sits directly alongside DOGE's weakest category, Developer & Ecosystem (20) -- a 62-point internal spread from a single structural fact: no issuer means no one to sue and no one to build.

TradFi Approved (52) reflects a stark logos-versus-capital gap -- four live spot ETFs and a Nasdaq-listed treasury vehicle (CleanCore/ZONE, HODO), but combined ETF AUM sits well under 0.5% of market cap.
Privacy & Confidentiality (25) -- a fully transparent ledger with no protocol-level confidentiality and no meaningful privacy tooling built for it.
Retail Grade holds with a 1.36-point margin over the tier floor.
The bottom AI tier here is not gate-driven -- raw 36.19 sits 18 points under its own binding cap, so the category layer alone produced it.
Execution Layer (50): ten-times-faster blocks than Bitcoin buy no faster practical settlement -- major exchanges require 40-60 confirmations for DOGE deposits against Bitcoin's common 2-6.
Economic Predictability (75) is DOGE's strongest AI category by a wide margin -- flat per-kB fees, no gas auction, no meaningful MEV.

watch_items: Neither axis is strong -- a convergence story rather than the more typical divergence pattern.
December 12, 2026 -- DogeReaper reaches two clean years; Security Posture becomes Partial-eligible. Both Fail and Partial share the 70 cap, so no score change is expected from this alone.
CLARITY Act passage would move DOGE's regulatory classification from agency-level guidance to statutory footing, lifting the residual Regulatory & Risk debit.
